economic_edge_requires: Reused research NEVER yields PROVEN_EDGE on its own without untouched prospective OOS.
Positive 1x AND 2x all-cost net expectancy with NY-day block bootstrap 95% CI > 0 AND Holm-Bonferroni survival.
Non-negative paired lift over NC_NULL_TRIGGER under balanced common support (|SMD| <= 0.10).
falsification_criteria.negative_result_validity: A negative economic finding with passing engineering/causality/QA gates is a valid completed R2 outcome.

fill_time_net_risk_policy.realized_tail_disclosure: planned_net_risk_usd <= 2.50 is a planned stop estimate, NOT a physical cap on realized loss after adverse gaps/slippage.

B0_VS_B2_CROSS_UNIVERSE.reason: SI0/B0 (production A1 56,710 universe + production SL/TP geometry) and B2 (44,692 M1 trigger universe + structural unswept M15/H1 SL/TP geometry) differ in both universe and geometry; reported descriptively only, never attributed solely to entry.

E_ONLY_PAIRED_FIXED_GEOMETRY.identification_method: Exact common-support pairing on identical (opportunity_id, direction, decision_timestamp_ms, fill_mode) + stratified balance audit.
E_ONLY_PAIRED_FIXED_GEOMETRY.question: Q-E: Holding R2 verified-unswept SL/TP geometry, opportunity timestamp, direction, and fill mode fixed, does entry filter (B2_H1/H2/H3/H123) improve expectancy vs NC_NULL_TRIGGER?
E_ONLY_PAIRED_FIXED_GEOMETRY.unit_of_analysis: Opportunity-level paired delta & chronological 1-position trade-level comparison explicitly separating frequency reduction from per-trade quality.

E_X_G_FACTORIAL.question: 2x2 factorial decomposition crossing Entry Filter (ON vs NC_NULL_TRIGGER) x Geometry (R1 vs R2 verified-unswept).

G_ONLY_PAIRED_SAME_ENTRY.identification_method: Exact same-entry opportunity pairing (R1 geometry vs R2 verified-unswept geometry) preserving ALL unmatched & newly rejected candidates.
G_ONLY_PAIRED_SAME_ENTRY.question: Q-G: Holding entry arm predicate fixed, how does replacing R1 target resolver with R2 verified-unswept target resolver change eligibility, selection, planned risk, exits, and expectancy?

X_FIXED_FILL.question: Q-X (Fixed-Fill): Holding exact same trade IDs, fills, quantities, SL/TP, and exits fixed, what is exact Decimal net PnL under 1x/2x/3x costs and 0.0004 vs 0.0006 taker fee?

X_FULL_RERISKED_UNIVERSE.question: Q-X (Full-Universe Rerisked): Restarting from all 44,692 directional M1 opportunities under each cost scenario (1x/2x/3x and 0.0004/0.0006), what are the dynamically re-sized, re-filtered, 1-position chronological outcomes?
